sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter (18B active) multimodal open model which outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world tasks at one-tenth the price. GLM-5.3-Flash is the smaller version of GLM-5.3 and rivals Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Model Overview GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, delivering stronger intelligence than GLM-5.2 at an exceptionally low cost. Highly Efficient Hybrid Architecture GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total parameters with 18B activated.

sources.title: How to Run GLM-5.3-Flash Locally (2026 Guide) - codersera.com
sources.snippet: Z.ai published the GLM-5.3-Flash weights on Hugging Face on 25 August 2026 under an MIT licence — the model that had been serving anonymously as "Ox Alpha" on OpenRouter.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash by Z.ai | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series: a 320-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters per token and a one-million-token context window, built for coding and agentic work.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.
